observations.statement: CrazyGames offers midgame video ads, rewarded ads and in-game banners through its SDK.
observations.excerpt: These types of advertisements are available through the CrazyGames SDK: Video ads Midgame ads: between levels or stages Rewarded ads: when giving a reward (CrazyGames provides fallback banners) In-game banners

observations.statement: Only ads requested through the CrazyGames SDK are allowed.
observations.excerpt: Only Ads requested through the CrazyGames SDK are allowed.

observations.statement: During Basic Launch, ads on CrazyGames are disabled and no revenue is shared.
observations.excerpt: If your game is currently in the Basic Launch phase: Advertisements will be disabled; no revenue will be shared.

observations.statement: CrazyGames caps midroll frequency at one every 3 minutes, managed by the SDK.
observations.excerpt: We take care automatically of how often a midgame ad is shown, taking into account the start of the game, the midroll frequency (max 1 every 3 minutes) and interplay with rewarded ads

observations.statement: CrazyGames forbids levels that can only be completed through a rewarded ad.
observations.excerpt: Poorly designed levels that can only be completed by a rewarded ad are not acceptable.

observations.statement: In-game banners on CrazyGames are allowed only on useful screens open at least 5 seconds on average.
observations.excerpt: In-game banners are only allowed on useful screens with content that are open for at least 5 seconds on average.

observations.statement: Players with ad blockers must be able to play CrazyGames games normally.
observations.excerpt: Players with AdBlocker should be able to play the game normally: It is never allowed to block players with AdBlockers from playing, or penalize players with certain disadvantages
